declarations.reason: GH013 since 2026-10-14: ruleset main-protection requires a pull request and the `npm run check` status on refs/heads/main, and GITHUB_TOKEN has no bypass. bolao_provider_snapshot.yml (br2026) and br2026_broadcast_epg.yml pushed generated data straight to main, so every run with new data failed after 5 rejected pushes and the data never reached the repository. Both files are matched by this surface only because they live under .github/workflows; neither sends e-mail.
declarations.expected_behavior_change: Generated data is committed to a rolling branch auto/data/<name> (fast-forward only, never force-pushed, never main) and one rolling PR per branch is opened or updated against main; the workflow dispatches safety_check.yml on that branch so the required `npm run check` runs on the PR head. Merge stays governed by the unchanged ruleset. The direct Pages deploy dispatch is removed from both workflows: Pages deploys on the merge push. Triggers, cron, dry-run behavior, pre-publication validators and concurrency are unchanged. Adds `pull-requests: write`.
